title: Partition positivity: audit and repair the tableau involution
objective: Attempt a complete constructive coefficientwise e-positivity proof beginning with the supplied arm-leg and corner-slide constructions; retain exact obstructions and prove the strongest valid repair without presenting partial results as a general solution.
deliverables: Source-status and proof audit with primary references
Actual P-tableau enumerator checked by an independent proper-coloring oracle
Precisely stated universal repair lemmas, independent criticism, and checked Lean proofs
Illustrated article and an explicit account of the unsolved obligations
success_criteria: A complete general constructive positivity proof and its formal bridge are required to report the original research objective as achieved
For an incomplete investigation, preserve exact counterexamples and report the full objective as unresolved; a useful repair is not completion
Formalization uses actual tableau validity and identifies any absent symmetric-function bridge
All claimed finite computations are reproducible and all claimed Lean checks are executed
stop_conditions: At most two mathematical proposal/review rounds for this bounded investigation
A false premise is refuted; preserve it and develop a scoped repair rather than assert the original result
No full solution survives review; report remaining obligations explicitly
No paid compute or new provider dependency is required
